description: ADR-0043 decision 3: the text parameters of the built-in tools that write human-readable text outside the platform: every external_send tool, and the write tools that create or change a pull request, an issue, a case, a ticket or a page with a description or body. The categories do not change: a write tool listed here keeps its approval defaults. The worker appends the AI disclosure marker to each listed parameter before the call. A path is a top-level argument (`comment`), a text field of each object in a top-level list (`inline_comments[].comment_text`), or an RFC 6901 JSON pointer into a JSON document argument (`issue_json#/fields/description`). The document argument can be a JSON string or an object; a string that is not a JSON object is left as it is. An absent or empty text field in a document gets the marker only, and an Atlassian Document Format value gets the marker as a last paragraph. Update tools with a document argument are not listed: an absent field would replace the text that the item has. `format` markdown targets render HTML comments as hidden, so the marker carries the run id there; plain targets get the text only; html targets get the text as an escaped paragraph. Every external_send tool of tool-categories-v1.json is listed under toolkits or under exempt with a reason. Read by the Rust worker and by elitea-main (the opt-out toolkit types); elitea-main keeps a copy that a test holds equal.

jira.update_comment_with_file: Adds a file to a comment that exists. The tool writes no text of its own.
